content:
If you're trying to change your email account password, this should be completed first via your email providers webmail settings page.

After doing so, open the below TB-A setting pages. Enter your new password on each.

  1. Settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server
  2. Settings > account name > sending mail > outgoing server

Note: No password is stored for Oauth 2.0 authentication.
